mentions.name: Swipe-based music library explorer
mentions.description: This tool makes managing and exploring an existing music library easier. Users set filters such as BPM, key, decade, and genre, then swipe through random songs to accept or reject them for inspiration or playlists. It also tracks weekly trending tracks on TikTok, YouTube, and SoundCloud with region-based filtering, and automatically builds smart playlists from user-defined rules. It works with existing local, Apple Music, Spotify, and SoundCloud libraries, and is compatible with Beets.
mentions.problem: Managing and exploring a personal music library is slow and uncreative.
mentions.source_excerpt:
so I'm working on side project to make managing and exploring your music library easier.

The idea is you can set a few filters (like bpm, key, decade, genre) and then swipe through random songs, accept or reject them for inspiration or playlists. Kinda like Tinder but for digging through your own tracks.
